metaBuilds.synergy: Armor and shields let Adele live in melee where Crown of Thorns feeds allies bonus true damage; Dawnstar first because her basic attacks apply its weakening stacks fastest.

items.Dawnstar: First — melee hits apply 2 weakening stacks, blunting whoever she punches.
items.Xenia: Second — shields the ally she peels for, plus armor against both damage types.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Caps the core — missing-health regen and tenacity keep her re-entering fights.

metaBuilds.holes: It brings zero damage of its own — if allies can't cash in her Thorns and roots, she just tanks politely.

metaBuilds.synergy: Dynamo punishes everything her Imperial Lash root and Queen's Garden lock down, while Gaia Greaves speed stacks keep her chasing and Vanguardian rounds out both armors.

items.Dynamo: First — her roots make marked targets take extra damage for allies.
items.Gaia Greaves: Movement stacks turn into bonus hits while running down rooted targets.
items.Vanguardian: Finishes the core with both armors and tenacity for repeated engages.

metaBuilds.holes: The weakest of the three cores at 51.4% — mostly utility stats, and the rotation damage stays tiny.

metaBuilds.synergy: Same Dawnstar-Xenia frontline core, but Tainted Guard adds healing cuts against lifesteal divers who sit on Adele while she holds them inside Queen's Garden.

items.Dawnstar: First — melee hits stack its damage-reduction debuff on divers.
items.Xenia: Second — ally shields plus mixed armor while she body-blocks.
items.Tainted Guard: Attackers who hit her eat a healing cut and a bleed.

optimizer.synergy: Pure durability so Adele can stand in melee applying Crown of Thorns; Stonewall first because physical armor is what her dive-in eats.

items.Stonewall: First — 70 physical armor plus 5% physical mitigation for holding the front.
items.Vainglory: Stacks Vanity while she brawls, up to 10 stacks of armor.
items.Raiment of Renewal: 80 tenacity keeps her roots landing; missing-health regen refills her between fights.
items.Frostguard: Chilling Presence saps attacker attack speed while she holds the front.
items.Catalytic Drive: Deconstruct heals her on-hit and pays gold from the front line.
items.Warp Stream: Tele-Blink is a shorter-cooldown reposition, plus 25 ultimate haste for Queen's Garden.

optimizer.holes: It brings no damage of its own — if allies cannot cash in her Thorns and roots, she just absorbs politely.

items.Elafrost: The empowered slow attack keeps rooted targets from ever escaping.
